steps.run: AGENT_NAME=${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}; LOWER_NAME=$(echo $AGENT_NAME | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); IS_READONLY=false; case $LOWER_NAME in *analyst*) IS_READONLY=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_READONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED] READ-ONLY agent=$AGENT_NAME attempted edit at $(date -u +\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\")" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo '⛔ WARNING: Read-only agent (T2.5/T3) attempted a file edit. This action is logged and may be rejected.'; else echo "[SAFETY-EDIT] agent=$AGENT_NAME at $(date -u +\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\")" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi
